name: Basilique Sainte-Anne-du-Congo
subtitle: The basilica was designed by the architect Roger Erell with the engineers William Barnett and then Grandmaître.

facts.label: Architect

facts.label: Built
facts.value: Works began in 1943 and were not finished at the inauguration in 1949

parts.text: The basilica was designed by the architect Roger Erell with the engineers William Barnett and then Grandmaître. Works began in 1943 and it was inaugurated in 1949, still unfinished.
